integrity: The exact damping infimum is proved analytically from the diffusion coefficients printed in the source. The Example 5.2 arithmetic is checked independently by a bundled standard-library script. The motivating paper's model equations, Theorem 4.2, proof, Example 5.2, Example 5.3, and conclusions were inspected directly.
scientific_limitations: The result invalidates a uniform damping step in the published extinction proof but does not prove persistence or non-extinction.
The true top Lyapunov exponent of the Example 5.2 infection subsystem is not computed.
Quadratic noise can still affect nonlinear dynamics away from the disease-free boundary.
A different state-dependent extinction argument might recover some cases that the corrected uniform bound does not certify.
title: Exact small-infection Itô damping exposes a quadratic-noise extinction gap in a stochastic SEI model
